description: This file is a Java interface named PermissionDao, extending a generic DAO interface, defining CRUD and query operations related to Permission objects in a sales management system.

classes.name: PermissionDao
classes.description: A Java interface for data access operations related to Permission entities, extending a generic DAO interface.

methods.name: listPermission
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all Permission objects.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Permission object by its unique ID.

methods.name: getPermissionsListByGroups
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Permissions associated with the provided set of permission IDs.

methods.name: listByCriteria
methods.description: Lists Permissions based on specified search criteria encapsulated in PermissionCriteria.
